name: Purple eryngo
desc: Purple eryngo (Eryngium leavenworthii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 26 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Eryngium leavenworthii, also known as Leavenworth's eryngo, is an annual plant in the family Apiaceae that is native to the central United States. It can reach heights up to 3 feet.
